description: Registro Nacional de Parques Industriales (RENPI) is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Industria, Comercio y de la Pequeña y Mediana Empresa. El Registro Nacional de Parques Industriales (RENPI) tiene como objetivo recolectar, monitorear y sistematizar información sobre los Parques Industriales en el país y las empresas radicadas en ellos. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Industria, Comercio y de la Pequeña y Mediana Empresa. Its tags are Parque Empresarial, Parques Industriales, Parques Tecnológicos, Polo Industrial. It offers 1 resource(s) in ODS. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
